## Calculating malaria prevalence in collected *Culex quinquefasciatus* mosquitoes at Kīpahulu Valley, Maui in 2002 and 2019

The dataset used is from a USGS data release referenced below: [10.5066/P1BDBYFY](https://doi.org/10.5066/P1BDBYFY). Adult *Culex quinquefasciatus* mosquitoes were trapped in 2002 and again in 2019 in Kīpahulu Valley. Collected mosquitoes were tested for malaria infection status. Malaria prevalence was then calculated by taking the average of all the infection statuses, as infection can be coded as 0s and 1s (binary).

```{r}
#load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(ggthemr)
ggthemr("dust") #set theme for plots
```

```{r}
#import malaria dataset from Kīpahulu Valley, collected in 2002 and 2019
kipa2002 <- read.csv(here("Week_08", "Data","kipa2002data.csv"))
```

```{r}
#save functions
#standard error of the mean (just for reference for myself)
se <- function(x) {
  sqrt(var(x)/length(x))
}

#standard error of the binomial, for prevalence data where you have 0s and 1st
se.final <- function(p, n) {
  ifelse(sqrt(p*(1-p)/n)==0, (( 1-0.05^(1/n))/2), sqrt(p*(1-p)/n))
}

#plotting function
prevplot <- function(data, x, y, z) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x={{x}}, y={{y}}, color={{z}})) +
    geom_point() 
}
```

```{r}
#calculate prevalence using the standard error for binomials function 
prev1 <- kipa2002 |>  
  group_by(site, year) |>  
  summarize(
    prev=mean(diss_inf_all, na.rm=TRUE),
    prev_n = length(diss_inf_all),
    prev_se=se.final(prev, prev_n)
    ) 

```

```{r}
#create plots showing malaria prevalence across years using the plotting function
prevplot(data=prev1, x=year, y=prev, z=site) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prev - prev_se, ymax= prev + prev_se), width=0.2) +
  labs(title="Malaria Prevalence of Collected Culex 
  Mosquitoes at Kīpahulu Valley", x="Year Collected", y="Malaria Prevalence", color="Site")

ggsave(here("Week_08", "Outputs", "HWplot1.png"), width=5, height=7)

#plot showing malaria prevalence across different sites 
prevplot(data=prev1, x=site, y=prev, z=as.factor(year)) + #had to change year into a factor for it to plot it? 
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = prev - prev_se, ymax= prev + prev_se), width=0.2) +
  labs(title = "Malaria Prevalence of Collected Culex 
  Mosquitoes at Kīpahulu Valley", x="Site", y="Malaria Prevalence", color="Year")

ggsave(here("Week_08", "Outputs", "HWplot2.png"), width=5, height=7)

```
